figures.shows: The Third-Person sample in the Motion debug view half a second after the robot starts to run to the right, with the follow camera 4.5 m behind it and moving after it. The game's HUD is hidden
figures.caption: The motion view while the camera follows the robot to the right: the still ground and trees share one blue-green, brighter where they are near, and the far sky stays dark. The tree at the right is nearest and brightest. The running robot shows green and orange, and its limbs differ from its body.
figures.alt: An island course tinted blue-green under a dark sky, the near tree at the right a flat bright blue-green. A running robot in olive green has an arm in bright green and a foot in orange.
